title: Fixer step result
description: The machine-readable tail of a drive-fixer dispatch. drive-scope-check.mjs validates touched_files against the finding's fence (finding files union declared_extra) and rejects a violation once before re-dispatching.

applied.description: False is a correct outcome for an obsolete finding or one that turns out to need diagnosis — say which in note.

touched_files.description: Every repo-relative path this fix created, edited or deleted.

declared_extra.description: Files outside the finding's own that the fix had to touch, each with the reason. Declared is allowed; undeclared is what the fence rejects.

note.description: obsolete | needs-diagnosis | one line on what changed.
